title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Decision dossier for a binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, sober copy, project identity, operator density, theme tokens, and local fonts. The appended [Navigation citizenship](index.html#navigation-citizenship) chapter adds light and dark tree variants, recommends a monochrome document icon with a neutral waiting-decision counter, defines active, hover, child, History, and zero-visible states, and separates a follow-up Dossiers slice from shared tree and catalogue dependencies.
